ai.purpose: RTT/1 engine layer for Evolutionary Biology: operator grammar, dimensional mapping, adaptive behavior, and minimal coherence examples.

engine.description: Defines the operator grammar and dimensional behavior of evolutionary processes within the RTT substrate.

variation.description: Introduces differences among individuals through mutation, recombination, and developmental noise.

selection.description: Differential reproductive success based on environmental fit.

inheritance.description: Transmission of lineage information across generations.

drift.description: Random fluctuations in allele frequencies due to finite population size.

adaptation.description: Population-level alignment with environmental constraints through repeated selection cycles.

gene_flow.description: Movement of genetic material between populations.

population_structure.description: Spatial or social organization that shapes evolutionary dynamics.

environmental_pressure.description: Environmental constraints that shape selection gradients.

dimensional_mapping.R1: Primitive replicator dynamics; minimal lineage memory; high stochasticity.
dimensional_mapping.R2: Genetic mechanisms and molecular variation; partial expression of adaptive patterns.
dimensional_mapping.R3: Full population-level evolutionary dynamics; stable selection and adaptation cycles.

integration.notes: RTT/1 treats evolution as an operator-driven adaptive system; deeper resonance and lineage structures are resolved in RTT/2 and RTT/3.
